new = '''import itertools
_n16 = ['S%d'%i for i in range(16)]
_sv16 = svc(*[(n, i+1) for i, n in enumerate(_n16)])
def _words(nw):
    pre = list(itertools.product(range(16), repeat=4))[:nw]

check('row bound accepted', [_r[0]['ok'], len(_r[0]['image']['rows']), _r[0]['image']['rows'][0][:2]],
      [True, 6476, [1, 4294967295]])
check('row bound rejected', runjob([st(1, _bigpol(8192))], services=_sv16), [RE])
'''
